sections.title: Comprehensive income tax scale (national)
sections.basis: comprehensive income tax base (종합소득과세표준) per year
sections.note: Paid by: resident individuals. Applies to: Individual filing unit; also applied to retirement income via art. 55(2). Local income tax adds 10% of this tax (see A3).

sections.title: Earned income deduction (근로소득공제) schedule
sections.basis: total salary (총급여액) per year; deduction = marginal percentage of salary in each band
sections.note: Paid by: employees. Applies to: Deduction capped at 20,000,000 KRW; daily workers 150,000 KRW per day. Rates are deduction percentages, not tax rates (350만원 + 40% over 500만원, etc.).

sections.title: Earned income tax credit (근로소득세액공제) schedule
sections.basis: computed income tax attributable to earned income; credit = 55% of first 1.3M + 30% above
sections.note: Paid by: employees. Applies to: Credit capped: total salary ≤33M: 740,000; 33M–70M: 740,000 − (salary−33M)×8/1000, min 660,000; 70M–120M: 660,000 − (salary−70M)×1/2, min 500,000; >120M: 500,000 − (salary−120M)×1/2, min 200,000. Rates are credit percentages of computed tax.

rows.label: Earned income deduction cap
rows.note: earned income deduction per year. Paid by: employees.

rows.label: Earned income deduction for daily workers
rows.note: daily wage. Paid by: daily workers (일용근로자).

rows.label: Basic personal deduction (기본공제) per person
rows.note: comprehensive income, per qualifying person (taxpayer, spouse, dependants). Paid by: resident individuals. Applies to: Spouse/dependants with income ≤1,000,000 KRW (or only salary ≤5,000,000); lineal ascendants 60+, descendants ≤20, siblings ≤20 or 60+.

rows.label: Additional deduction: aged 70+
rows.note: per qualifying person.

rows.label: Additional deduction: disabled person
rows.note: per qualifying person.

rows.label: Additional deduction: women (single head of household with dependants, or married), income ≤30M
rows.note: per year. Applies to: comprehensive income ≤ 30,000,000 KRW.

rows.label: Additional deduction: single parent
rows.note: per year.

rows.label: Earned income tax credit cap (salary ≤ 33M)
rows.note: earned income tax credit per year. Paid by: employees. Applies to: total salary ≤ 33,000,000 KRW (reduced caps with floors 660,000 / 500,000 / 200,000 at higher salaries).

rows.label: Child tax credit (자녀세액공제)
rows.value: 1 child: 250,000 KRW/yr; 2 children: 550,000 KRW/yr; 3+: 550,000 + 400,000 per child beyond 2. Birth/adoption year: 300,000 (1st), 500,000 (2nd), 700,000 (3rd+)
rows.note: Article last amended 2026-04-21.

rows.label: Rural special tax (농어촌특별세) – headline rates
rows.value: 20% of income/corporate tax, customs, acquisition and registration tax reductions under special tax laws; 10% of reductions of tax on interest/dividends; 10% of individual consumption tax (30% on the ICT for golf-course admission, ICT art. 1(3)4); 0.15% of transfer value of securities traded on designated markets; 10% of acquisition tax computed at 2%; 20% of leisure tax; 20% of comprehensive real estate holding tax

sections.title: Personal local income tax scale (개인지방소득세, standard rates)
sections.basis: comprehensive income tax base per year
sections.note: Paid by: resident individuals. Equals 1/10 of the national income tax rates.

rows.label: Local income tax special withholding (10% of withheld income tax)
rows.note: income tax withheld (wages, interest, dividends, freelance fees, etc.). Paid by: withholding agents. Gives 1.4% on 14% interest/dividend WHT and 0.3% on 3% freelance WHT.

rows.label: Withholding on wages of daily workers
rows.note: daily wages after 150,000 KRW/day deduction. Paid by: daily workers. Applies to: 55% of the computed tax is credited (art. 59(3)).

rows.label: Monthly wage withholding method
rows.value: Monthly wages and public pensions are withheld using the earned income simplified tax table (근로소득 간이세액표) set by Presidential Decree; regular employees otherwise at the basic rates
rows.note: Paid by: employers.

rows.label: Foreign employees – flat 19% withholding option
rows.note: monthly employment income. Paid by: foreign employees electing the flat-rate regime.

rows.label: Non-resident taxation method (employment and other Korean-source income)
rows.value: Non-residents with a Korean PE or real-estate income are taxed on aggregated Korean-source income using resident rules (basic 6%–45% scale) but only the personal deduction for themselves (no dependant, special income deductions, child or special tax credits); non-residents without a PE are taxed separately per income type (withholding). Foreign employees may elect the flat 19% regime (see H3).
rows.note: Paid by: non-residents.

sections.title: Pension income deduction (연금소득공제)
sections.basis: total pension income per year; deduction percentages
sections.note: Applies to: Deduction capped at 9,000,000 KRW

rows.label: Private pension separate-taxation threshold
rows.note: private pension income (other than retirement-income pensions) per year. Applies to: Private pension income up to this amount may be taxed separately instead of aggregated.

rows.label: Withholding on pension-account annuities by age
rows.value: Under 70: 5%; 70-79: 4%; 80+: 3%; life annuity contracts 3%

rows.label: Housing rental income separate taxation rate
rows.note: rental business income (gross minus 50% deemed expenses; 60% for registered rental housing). Paid by: residents with housing rental receipts ≤ 20,000,000 KRW/yr. Applies to: Optional separate taxation; extra 2,000,000 KRW deduction (4,000,000 for registered rental housing) if other comprehensive income ≤ 20,000,000.

rows.label: Housing rental separate-taxation eligibility threshold
rows.note: total housing rental receipts per year.

sections.basis: capital gains tax base per year

sections.basis: capital gains tax base on shares per year

rows.note: capital gains tax base. Paid by: residents. Applies to: Housing, union membership rights and pre-sale rights: 60%.

rows.label: CGT: real estate held < 1 year
rows.note: capital gains tax base. Paid by: residents. Applies to: Housing, union membership rights and pre-sale rights: 70%.

rows.label: CGT: unregistered real estate
rows.note: capital gains tax base.

rows.value: Basic scale + 20pp (2 homes) or + 30pp (3+ homes) for housing in adjustment target areas (조정대상지역)
rows.note: Paid by: multi-home households. Applies to: Statutory rule in art. 104(7); application may be suspended by Enforcement Decree (not checked).

rows.label: CGT: shares sold by non-major shareholders
rows.value: SME shares 10%; other shares 20%
rows.note: Paid by: non-major shareholders (taxable transactions, e.g. unlisted or off-exchange).

rows.label: CGT: derivatives
rows.note: capital gains tax base. Applies to: May be reduced by up to 75% by Presidential Decree (art. 104(6)).

rows.label: Virtual asset income tax (enacted, from 2027)
rows.note: virtual asset income minus 2,500,000 KRW per year. Paid by: residents. Applies to: Applies to virtual assets transferred or lent on or after 2027-01-01; not taxed before then.

rows.label: Virtual asset income basic deduction (from 2027)
rows.note: virtual asset income per year.

sections.basis: qualifying dividends (특례배당소득) per year
sections.note: Paid by: resident shareholders of qualifying listed companies (payout ≥ 40%, or ≥ 25% with ≥ 10% growth). Applies to: Optional; dividends arising up to business years including 2028-12-31; applies to dividends resolved for business years starting on/after 2026-01-01 (Act No. 21223)

sections.title: Dividends, interest and payments to non-residents

rows.label: Withholding on interest (residents, general)
rows.note: interest paid. Paid by: resident individuals. Applies to: Non-business loan interest 25% (14% via registered P2P platforms); unidentified real-name income 45%. Plus local income tax 10% of the tax (1.4%).

rows.label: Withholding on non-business loan interest
rows.note: non-business lending interest (비영업대금의 이익). Paid by: resident individuals.

rows.label: Withholding on dividends (residents, general)
rows.note: dividends paid. Paid by: resident individuals. Applies to: Silent-partner (출자공동사업자) dividends 25%. Plus local income tax 10% of the tax (1.4%).

rows.label: Financial income comprehensive taxation threshold
rows.note: interest + dividend income per year. Applies to: Withheld interest and dividends totalling ≤ 20,000,000 KRW are taxed separately (final withholding); above it they are aggregated into comprehensive income.

rows.label: Withholding on income with unverified real name
rows.note: interest and dividends where real name not confirmed.

rows.label: Non-resident WHT: interest on government/domestic corporate bonds
rows.note: gross payment. Paid by: non-residents without PE. Applies to: Domestic law rate; treaty rates may be lower. Plus local income tax 10% of the tax.

rows.label: Non-resident WHT: other interest
rows.note: gross payment. Paid by: non-residents without PE. Applies to: Domestic law rate; treaty rates may be lower.

rows.label: Non-resident WHT: dividends
rows.note: gross payment. Paid by: non-residents without PE. Applies to: Domestic law rate; treaty rates may be lower.

rows.label: Non-resident WHT: royalties
rows.note: gross payment. Paid by: non-residents without PE. Applies to: Domestic law rate; treaty rates may be lower.

rows.label: Non-resident WHT: personal services income
rows.note: gross payment. Paid by: non-residents. Applies to: 3% for certain services rendered abroad deemed Korean-source under treaty.

rows.label: Non-resident WHT: securities transfer gains
rows.value: 10% of gross proceeds, or lesser of 10% of proceeds and 20% of gain where cost is verified
rows.note: Paid by: non-residents.

rows.label: Non-resident WHT: shipping/aircraft rental and business income
rows.note: gross payment. Paid by: non-residents without PE.

rows.label: WHT on foreign corporations: dividends / royalties / other interest
rows.note: gross payment. Paid by: foreign corporations without PE. Applies to: Interest on government/domestic corporate bonds 14%; treaty rates may be lower.
